choices.why: A pale solid-birch rectangular table sized for four (125 cm) that fits the free floor beside the kitchenette and matches its light wood fronts.
Classic black spindle-back chairs give the Nordic contrast the user wants against the pale table and white walls.
A simple white bell pendant that disappears against the white ceiling and suits the minimal Nordic look over the table.
Its white case and pale wood fronts blend with the white wall and the light kitchen cabinetry while giving storage at a low height.

answer.why: Light wood, white and black echo the kitchenette's pale wood and white units and the grey-oak floor, giving a calm, simple Nordic dining corner. The black spindle chairs add the graphic contrast.
